pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a failing test as spec. It makes %, _ and \ literal in the title search, which is what the PR says. Nothing else changed.
No spec file in the change.

The new tests insert titles containing %, _ and a backslash. They assert exact result lists, so they would fail with the old wildcard behaviour. I did not run them: the cloudflare workers pool may not be available here, and CI covers it.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. I found no docs describing the search.
The escape regex covers \, % and _. The ESCAPE '\\' clause in the JS string becomes ESCAPE '\' in SQL. The query stays parameterised.
The query is bound with a parameter and the escaping reduces injection-like wildcard abuse. No secrets or planted instructions.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: five items after the test inserts, and the ESCAPE clause.
